'''''Star Wars: Age of Resistance''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] miniseries in [[Marvel Comics]]' [[Age of Star Wars|Age of ''Star Wars'']] maxi-series, which spans three eras of ''[[Star Wars]]'' storytelling. The series is written by [[Tom Taylor]] and focuses on heroes and villains from the [[sequel trilogy]] era.
